name: Volcango
storyline: You've made it to a secret island in the Bermuda Triangle. Here, animals long thought lost to the world have revived. A magic volcano gives life...but also takes it away. The animals must fight to the death to earn their second chance at survival on the volcano's rim. Defeating all of their rivals through skill, opportune moments, and a little bit of luck pleases the gods. The gods themselves succumbed to the volcano millions of years ago.
summary: Avoid extinction on a volcanic roulette wheel! Gather up to three friends and dunk each other into lava -- but be careful on territory of the sleeping gods. In this turn-based, fast-play game, survival favors neither the fittest nor the bold, but the smartest (and sometimes, the luckiest). 2-4 players, 15 minute sessions.
